metric_semantics.crazygames.rating: Displayed score labeled last six months; scale maximum not explicitly present in observed text. Not a usage metric.
metric_semantics.crazygames.likes: Displayed positive vote count; accumulation window unspecified. K means 1000, M means 1000000; rounding method unknown.
metric_semantics.crazygames.dislikes: Displayed negative vote count; same precision and time-window limits as likes.
metric_semantics.crazygames.plays: No game-level plays observed; null is not zero.
metric_semantics.crazygames.active_users: No game-level active users observed; never inferred from votes.

limitations: 20 selected records covering 19 unique games and five unique detail inspections; bounded nonrandom sample, not exhaustive.
Homepage section and region labels are retained exactly as rendered; historical scope labels may differ.
All metric and selection times are fresh observations from this run; unchanged displayed values do not prove zero underlying activity.
Display positions are not official numeric ranks; vote totals and ratings are not player counts or active-user counts.
Five unique homepage detail pages inspected; Bloxd.io detail observations are shared by its two independently selected records. Other game-level metrics remain null, not zero.
Seven Hot-only games have no description: gameplay text was not visible within the bounded detail sample. No mechanics are inferred from titles or covers.
The Hot page has conflicting month-title and 24-hour introduction wording.
A preexisting logged-out browser session may affect recommendations. Recently played sidebar cards are excluded.

Twenty cover files and thirteen description records are reused independent metadata with original timestamps. All cover URLs were freshly re-observed and matched exactly. Local bytes were decoded and checked against SHA-256 and the current remote Git blob hash; no new download was needed.
No login, hidden API, manual gameplay or video playback used; embedded games may load automatically. A non-confirming game alert was dismissed to read public detail metadata.
Source cover copyrights remain with their respective owners; no redistribution license asserted.

data_policy.content_storage: factual game discovery metadata and short assistant-generated Chinese summaries
data_policy.rights_note: Source images remain owned by their respective rights holders. Downloading and public visibility do not establish a redistribution license. No full descriptions, videos, game code or other game assets stored.
